# fhir-registry

> A Go library for loading, indexing, and reasoning about FHIR structure
> definitions. It is the single source of truth for FHIR structure knowledge,
> designed to handle arbitrary implementation guides.

## Overview

`fhir-registry` is a Go library (module `github.com/jlcoulter/fhir-registry`,
package `fhir`) that loads FHIR packages, indexes their structure definitions
and terminology/conformance resources, and exposes element trees for
reasoning about and normalising FHIR instances.

## Key types

- `Registry` — concurrency-safe index of `StructureDefinition`s by canonical
  URL and base type, with cached element trees. The central entry point.
- `ElementTree` — recursively-linked element tree for one definition
  (`SD`, `Root`, `ByPath`, `ByID`).
- `ElementDefinition` — structural definition with typed `Max` cardinality,
  `Children` tree, and `Slices` grouping.
- `Max` — int type where `MaxUnbounded` represents `"*"`.
- `PackageClient` — downloads FHIR packages from a registry server and caches
  them locally.
- `Scope` / `ScopePolicy` — narrow which resources a `Registry` indexes.
- `ValueSet`, `CodeSystem`, `CapabilityStatement`, `SearchParameter` — typed
  terminology/conformance resources.
- `Resource` — opaque generic resource (`ResourceType`, `ProfileURLs`, `Raw`).
- `MarshalReport` / `ReportItem` — diagnostics from `Registry.Marshal`.

## Entry points

- `NewRegistry()` — create a registry.
- `Registry.LoadPackage(dir)` / `Registry.LoadPackageTgz(path)` — load a
  package from a directory or `.tgz`.
- `Registry.LoadPackageWithDeps(ctx, dir, client)` — load a package and resolve
  its dependency chain.
- `Registry.Tree(url)` / `Registry.TreeForType(type)` — build an element tree.
- `Registry.Marshal(resourceType, instance)` — normalize an instance.
- `Registry.Definition(url)` / `Registry.DefinitionsForType(type)` — look up
  definitions.
- `Registry.Resolve()` — finalize a scoped registry.
- `MergeDifferential(base, differential)` — merge a differential onto a base
  snapshot.
- Cardinality helpers: `IsMulti`, `IsRequired`, `Cardinality`,
  `PrimaryTypeCode`, `IsChoice`, `ChoiceName`.

## Errors

Sentinel errors (`ErrDefinitionNotFound`, `ErrBaseDefinition`,
`ErrIncompleteDefinition`, `ErrPackageNotFound`, `ErrVersionNotFound`,
`ErrNetwork`, `ErrParseFailure`) are returned wrapped and usable with
`errors.Is`.

## Source layout

- `registry.go` — `Registry`, element trees, cardinality helpers
- `client.go` — `PackageClient`
- `resolver.go` — package loading and dependency resolution
- `scope.go` — `Scope`
- `resources.go` — terminology and conformance resource types
- `marshal.go` — instance normalization
- `merge.go` — differential-to-snapshot merging
- `errors.go` — sentinel errors
